Buffer<float16_t> g_input      : register(t0);
Buffer<float16_t> g_rpe        : register(t1);
Buffer<float16_t> g_n1w        : register(t2);
Buffer<float16_t> g_n1b        : register(t3);
Buffer<float16_t> g_qkvw       : register(t4);
Buffer<float16_t> g_qkvb       : register(t5);
Buffer<float16_t> g_projw      : register(t6);
Buffer<float16_t> g_projb      : register(t7);
Buffer<float16_t> g_n2w        : register(t8);
Buffer<float16_t> g_n2b        : register(t9);
Buffer<float16_t> g_fc1w       : register(t10);
Buffer<float16_t> g_fc1b       : register(t11);
Buffer<float16_t> g_fc2w       : register(t12);
Buffer<float16_t> g_fc2b       : register(t13);

RWBuffer<float16_t> g_output   : register(u0);

static const uint H = 720;
static const uint W = 1280;
static const uint C = 32;
static const uint Wh = 4;
static const uint Ww = 4;
static const uint N = 16;
static const uint nH = 180;
static const uint nW = 320;
static const uint HIDDEN = 128;

float my_erf(float x) {
    float sgn = (x < 0.0f) ? -1.0f : 1.0f;
    float ax = abs(x);
    float t = 1.0f / (1.0f + 0.3275911f * ax);
    float y = 1.0f - (((((1.061405429f * t - 1.453152027f) * t) + 1.421413741f) * t - 0.284496736f) * t + 0.254829592f) * t * exp(-ax * ax);
    return sgn * y;
}

[numthreads(32, 1, 1)]
void main(uint3 gid : SV_GroupID, uint3 tid : SV_GroupThreadID)
{
    uint win_id = gid.x;
    uint wy = win_id / nW;
    uint wx = win_id % nW;
    uint t = tid.x;

    bool active = (t < N);

    uint ty = t / Ww;
    uint tx = t % Ww;
    uint py = wy * Wh + ty;
    uint px = wx * Ww + tx;
    uint base_in = ((py * W) + px) * C;

    float x_in[C];
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) {
        x_in[c] = active ? (float)g_input[base_in + c] : 0.0f;
    }

    // LN1
    float mean = 0.0f, var = 0.0f;
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) mean += x_in[c];
    mean *= (1.0f / (float)C);
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) { float d = x_in[c] - mean; var += d*d; }
    var *= (1.0f / (float)C);
    float inv = rsqrt(var + 1e-5f);

    float xn[C];
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) {
        float w = (float)g_n1w[c];
        float b = (float)g_n1b[c];
        xn[c] = active ? ((x_in[c] - mean) * inv * w + b) : 0.0f;
    }

    // QKV
    float q[C], k[C], v[C];
    [unroll] for (uint o = 0; o < C; ++o) {
        float sq = (float)g_qkvb[o];
        float sk = (float)g_qkvb[o + 32];
        float sv = (float)g_qkvb[o + 64];
        [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) {
            float xv = xn[c];
            sq += xv * (float)g_qkvw[o * 32 + c];
            sk += xv * (float)g_qkvw[(o + 32) * 32 + c];
            sv += xv * (float)g_qkvw[(o + 64) * 32 + c];
        }
        q[o] = sq;
        k[o] = sk;
        v[o] = sv;
    }

    float scale = rsqrt((float)C);
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) q[c] *= scale;

    // Attention scores
    float attn_row[N];
    [unroll] for (uint j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
        float s = 0.0f;
        [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) {
            float kj = WaveReadLaneAt(k[c], j);
            s += q[c] * kj;
        }
        if (active) s += (float)g_rpe[t * N + j];
        attn_row[j] = s;
    }

    if (active) {
        float mx = attn_row[0];
        [unroll] for (uint j = 1; j < N; ++j) mx = max(mx, attn_row[j]);
        float sum = 0.0f;
        [unroll] for (uint j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            attn_row[j] = exp(attn_row[j] - mx);
            sum += attn_row[j];
        }
        float invs = 1.0f / sum;
        [unroll] for (uint j = 0; j < N; ++j) attn_row[j] *= invs;
    }

    float ao[C];
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) {
        float s = 0.0f;
        [unroll] for (uint j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            float vj = WaveReadLaneAt(v[c], j);
            s += attn_row[j] * vj;
        }
        ao[c] = active ? s : 0.0f;
    }

    float r1[C];
    [unroll] for (uint o = 0; o < C; ++o) {
        float s = (float)g_projb[o];
        [unroll] for (uint cc = 0; cc < C; ++cc) {
            s += ao[cc] * (float)g_projw[o * 32 + cc];
        }
        r1[o] = x_in[o] + s;
    }

    // LN2
    float mean2 = 0.0f, var2 = 0.0f;
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) mean2 += r1[c];
    mean2 *= (1.0f / (float)C);
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) { float d = r1[c] - mean2; var2 += d*d; }
    var2 *= (1.0f / (float)C);
    float inv2 = rsqrt(var2 + 1e-5f);

    float xn2[C];
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) {
        float w = (float)g_n2w[c];
        float b = (float)g_n2b[c];
        xn2[c] = active ? ((r1[c] - mean2) * inv2 * w + b) : 0.0f;
    }

    // Fused FC1 + GELU + FC2 + residual.
    // Compute FC2 output directly: out[o] = fc2b[o] + sum_h gelu(fc1[h]) * fc2w[o,h].
    // Restructure: accumulate per-output by streaming over h, avoiding HIDDEN-sized array.
    // But we need each h once, so compute h[] once in registers (HIDDEN=128 floats = 128 regs - tight).
    // Keep h in registers as before.
    float h[HIDDEN];
    [unroll] for (uint o = 0; o < HIDDEN; ++o) {
        float s = (float)g_fc1b[o];
        [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) {
            s += xn2[c] * (float)g_fc1w[o * 32 + c];
        }
        h[o] = 0.5f * s * (1.0f + my_erf(s * 0.70710678118f));
    }

    if (active) {
        [unroll] for (uint o = 0; o < C; ++o) {
            float s = (float)g_fc2b[o];
            [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < HIDDEN; ++c) {
                s += h[c] * (float)g_fc2w[o * HIDDEN + c];
            }
            g_output[base_in + o] = (float16_t)(r1[o] + s);
        }
    }
}

            float xv = xn[c];
            sq += xv * (float)g_qkvw[o * 32 + c];
            sk += xv * (float)g_qkvw[(o + 32) * 32 + c];
            sv += xv * (float)g_qkvw[(o + 64) * 32 + c];

        q[o] = sq * scale;
        k[o] = sk;
        v[o] = sv;

        ao[c] = s;

    mean2 *= (1.0f / (float)C);

    float inv2 = rsqrt(var2 + 1e-5f);

static const uint H = 720;
static const uint W = 1280;
static const uint C = 32;
static const uint Wh = 4;
static const uint Ww = 4;
static const uint N = 16;
static const uint nH = 180;
static const uint nW = 320;
static const uint HIDDEN = 128;

float my_erf(float x) {
    float sgn = (x < 0.0f) ? -1.0f : 1.0f;
    float ax = abs(x);
    float t = 1.0f / (1.0f + 0.3275911f * ax);
    float y = 1.0f - (((((1.061405429f * t - 1.453152027f) * t) + 1.421413741f) * t - 0.284496736f) * t + 0.254829592f) * t * exp(-ax * ax);
    return sgn * y;
}

[numthreads(32, 1, 1)]
void main(uint3 gid : SV_GroupID, uint3 tid : SV_GroupThreadID)
{
    uint pair_id = gid.x;
    uint t = tid.x;
    uint sub = t >> 4;
    uint token_id = t & 15u;

    uint win_id = pair_id * 2u + sub;
    uint wy = win_id / nW;
    uint wx = win_id % nW;

    uint ty = token_id >> 2;
    uint tx = token_id & 3u;
    uint py = wy * Wh + ty;
    uint px = wx * Ww + tx;
    uint base_in = ((py * W) + px) * C;

    float x_in[C];
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) {
        x_in[c] = (float)g_input[base_in + c];
    }

    // LN1
    float mean = 0.0f, var = 0.0f;
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) mean += x_in[c];
    mean *= (1.0f / (float)C);
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) { float d = x_in[c] - mean; var += d*d; }
    var *= (1.0f / (float)C);
    float inv = rsqrt(var + 1e-5f);

    float xn[C];
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) {
        float w = (float)g_n1w[c];
        float b = (float)g_n1b[c];
        xn[c] = (x_in[c] - mean) * inv * w + b;
    }

    // QKV with scale folded into q
    float scale = rsqrt((float)C);
    float q[C], k[C], v[C];
    [unroll] for (uint o = 0; o < C; ++o) {
        float sq = (float)g_qkvb[o];
        float sk = (float)g_qkvb[o + 32];
        float sv = (float)g_qkvb[o + 64];
        [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) {
            float xv = xn[c];
            sq += xv * (float)g_qkvw[o * 32 + c];
            sk += xv * (float)g_qkvw[(o + 32) * 32 + c];
            sv += xv * (float)g_qkvw[(o + 64) * 32 + c];
        }
        q[o] = sq * scale;
        k[o] = sk;
        v[o] = sv;
    }

    // Attention via wave shuffles within each half-warp.
    float attn_row[N];
    uint lane_base = sub * 16u;
    [unroll] for (uint j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
        float s = (float)g_rpe[token_id * N + j];
        uint src_lane = lane_base + j;
        [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) {
            float kj = WaveReadLaneAt(k[c], src_lane);
            s += q[c] * kj;
        }
        attn_row[j] = s;
    }

    float mx = attn_row[0];
    [unroll] for (uint j = 1; j < N; ++j) mx = max(mx, attn_row[j]);
    float sum = 0.0f;
    [unroll] for (uint j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
        attn_row[j] = exp(attn_row[j] - mx);
        sum += attn_row[j];
    }
    float invs = 1.0f / sum;
    [unroll] for (uint j = 0; j < N; ++j) attn_row[j] *= invs;

    float ao[C];
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) {
        float s = 0.0f;
        [unroll] for (uint j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            uint src_lane = lane_base + j;
            float vj = WaveReadLaneAt(v[c], src_lane);
            s += attn_row[j] * vj;
        }
        ao[c] = s;
    }

    float r1[C];
    [unroll] for (uint o = 0; o < C; ++o) {
        float s = (float)g_projb[o];
        [unroll] for (uint cc = 0; cc < C; ++cc) {
            s += ao[cc] * (float)g_projw[o * 32 + cc];
        }
        r1[o] = x_in[o] + s;
    }

    // LN2
    float mean2 = 0.0f, var2 = 0.0f;
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) mean2 += r1[c];
    mean2 *= (1.0f / (float)C);
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) { float d = r1[c] - mean2; var2 += d*d; }
    var2 *= (1.0f / (float)C);
    float inv2 = rsqrt(var2 + 1e-5f);

    float xn2[C];
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) {
        float w = (float)g_n2w[c];
        float b = (float)g_n2b[c];
        xn2[c] = (r1[c] - mean2) * inv2 * w + b;
    }

    // fc1 + GELU into h[HIDDEN], then fc2
    float h[HIDDEN];
    [unroll] for (uint o = 0; o < HIDDEN; ++o) {
        float s = (float)g_fc1b[o];
        [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < C; ++c) {
            s += xn2[c] * (float)g_fc1w[o * 32 + c];
        }
        h[o] = 0.5f * s * (1.0f + my_erf(s * 0.70710678118f));
    }

    [unroll] for (uint o = 0; o < C; ++o) {
        float s = (float)g_fc2b[o];
        [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < HIDDEN; ++c) {
            s += h[c] * (float)g_fc2w[o * HIDDEN + c];
        }
        g_output[base_in + o] = (float16_t)(r1[o] + s);
    }
}
